overview.description: The xETFs Korea AI Semiconductor ETF (KSMH) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF offering concentrated, targeted exposure to Koreas AI semiconductor industry, including advanced memory makers. The fund invests via publicly listed stocks, ADRs, or GDRs, but may also use swap agreements to gain exposure. KSMH was launched on Aug 19, 2026 and is issued by xETFs.

data.title: xETFs Launches ETF to Capture Leading Firms Across the Full Korea AI Semiconductor Ecosystem: KSMH
data.text: NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--xETFs launches KSMH, provides single-ticker access and exposure to Korea's largest AI chipmakers and broader Korean semiconductor industry.

news.t: xETFs Launches ETF to Capture Leading Firms Across the Full Korea AI Semiconductor Ecosystem: KSMH

holdings.infoBox: KSMH is an equity ETF with a total of 21 individual holdings. The top holdings are Samsung Electronics stock at 19.49%, SK hynix at 18.80%, HANMI Semiconductor at 8.17%, JUSUNG ENGINEERING at 5.13%, and LEENO Industrial at 4.99%.
